# Google广告还是AEO：成本、证据与本月行动

作者：@swiftagentsites  
日期：2026-11-02（北京时间）  
来源：[X原帖](https://x.com/swiftagentsites/status/2116931036672102826)  
分类：方法

## 中文全文

简短回答：AEO 可以部分替代广告，但目前还不适合用来解决任何紧急需求。

使用 Google Ads，你租来的是可见性，停止付费当天，它也就结束了。使用 AEO（答案引擎优化），你编写 AI 工具会读取的页面，让它们在有人问该联系谁时，能够提到你。你不用按点击付费，但见效更慢，无法控制回答措辞，也没人能承诺一定会提到你。

**一个广告线索要花多少钱**

WordStream 的 2026 年基准数据覆盖了 13,000 多个搜索广告系列：

- 房地产行业的平均每次点击成本为 3.22 美元，一年上涨了 27%。

- 平均每条线索成本为 102.51 美元，在 23 个行业中位居第三高。

- 而且，那些只是线索，不是成交客户。

广告仍然有效。几天就能启动，而且可以精确到点击层面进行衡量。但预算结束，可见性也随之结束。

此外，以点击告终的搜索也越来越少。SparkToro 与 Similarweb 发现，2026 年初，美国 68% 的 Google 搜索没有产生任何点击。

**有证据证明 AEO 有效吗？**

有一个方向，但还称不上证明。在 HousingWire 报道的一项研究中，来自 AI 的房地产线索在 90 天内的成交率为 9.6%，而 Zillow Premier 为 2.4%。这一数据来自一家 AI 可见性公司，所以应将它看作一个信号。

在我们自己的网站上，Google Search Console 统计到 10 月有 171 次 AI 回答展示。从月初每天约 2 次，增长到月底每天约 9 次，全部都没有付费。规模很小，而且只有一个月的数据，但确实在变化。

**警惕有关机器人流量的炒作**

我们的大多数机器人流量，并不是 AI 在读取我们。10 月的数据是：

- 34% 来自 Ahrefs 和 Semrush 这类 SEO 工具。

- 25% 来自其他脚本和采集程序。

- 只有约 7% 来自搜索与 AI 爬虫。

所以，要检查你实际迎来的究竟是哪些机器人。

**这个月可以做什么**

- 打开 [yourdomain.com/robots.txt](https://yourdomain.com/robots.txt)，确保 OAI-SearchBot、ChatGPT-User 和 PerplexityBot 没有被拦截。

- 一个页面回答一个买家问题，在前两句话中给出答案，并写明你的姓名、执照和所在城镇。

- 在其他网站上获得提及：本地媒体、协会、Reddit 讨论串。

- 每个月向 ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Google 提问同样的五个客户常见问题，并记下它们返回了哪些人或企业。

- 在联系表单中增加“你是怎么知道我的？”这一项，因为 AI 带来的访问经常会显示为直接访问或品牌搜索。

- 把广告留给短期推进需求，例如进入一个新城镇，或者某个月你需要在本周就获得电话咨询。

**如何分配资金**

先为基础建设付费，需要速度时再租流量。如果某个广告系列现在能为你盈利，不要为了测试这个方法就把它停掉。在继续投放的同时建设这些页面。

## 外文原文

Short answer: AEO is partly an alternative, and not yet for anything urgent.

With Google Ads you rent visibility, and it ends the day you stop paying. With AEO (answer engine optimization) you write the pages AI tools read, so they can name you when someone asks who to call. You don't pay per click, but it's slower, you don't control the wording, and nobody can promise you a mention.

**What an ad lead costs**

WordStream's 2026 benchmarks covered 13,000+ search campaigns:

- The average real estate click cost $3.22, up 27% in a year

- The average lead cost $102.51, the third highest of 23 industries

- And those are leads, not clients

Ads still work. They start in days and you can measure them down to the click. But when the budget ends, so does the visibility.

Fewer searches end in a click at all, too. SparkToro and Similarweb found 68% of US Google searches ended without one in early 2026.

**Is there proof AEO works?**

There's a direction, not proof. In a HousingWire-reported study, AI-sourced real estate leads closed at 9.6% within 90 days, against 2.4% on Zillow Premier. That number comes from an AI visibility company, so take it as a signal.

On our own site, Google Search Console counted 171 AI answer impressions in October. That went from about 2 a day early in the month to about 9 a day by the end, and none of it was paid. It's small and it's one month, but it's moving.

**Watch out for bot hype**

Most of our bot traffic wasn't AI reading us. In October:

- 34% was SEO tools like Ahrefs and Semrush

- 25% was other scripts and scrapers

- Only about 7% was search and AI crawlers

So check which bots you're actually getting.

**What to do this month**

- Open [yourdomain.com/robots.txt](https://yourdomain.com/robots.txt) and make sure OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User and PerplexityBot aren't blocked

- One buyer question per page, answered in the first two sentences, with your name, license and town

- Get mentioned on other sites: local press, associations, Reddit threads

- Ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google the same five questions your clients ask, once a month, and write down who comes back

- Add "How did you hear about me?" to your contact form, because AI-driven visits often show up as direct or branded search

- Keep ads for short pushes, like a new town or a month when you need calls this week

**How to split the money**

Pay for the foundation first, then rent when you need speed. If an ad campaign is profitable for you now, don't kill it to test this. Build the pages alongside it.
